## HAPI v0.25.3.3

### Compared with the previous maintained release

Rebuilt the personal nightly from current upstream `main`, inheriting the official conversation fork/rewind implementation and removing the previously carried Antigravity stack. This build carries 11 still-open PRs: #869, #897, #906, #912, #947, #955, #986, #997, #1087, #1245, and #1329.

### Compared with the official release

Adds structured SSE session patches, queued-message steering, send recovery, current Cursor ACP model mapping, project-group actions, sharing an existing session, Codex terminal-event protection, linked-worktree runner support, GitHub Copilot CLI support, and realtime transcription providers. The base also includes upstream changes through `3c3bffdf`, including the officially merged #1263.

### Maintained-fork guarantees

Release tags are published only from commits contained in `main`; macOS artifacts retain the `xyz.hapi.cli` signing identity; app-shell cache headers remain no-store; and PR #1320 (Antigravity) is excluded.
